mentions.name: Canine
mentions.description: An open source, self-hosted platform-as-a-service for Kubernetes that makes Kubernetes friendly and easy to use while staying powerful enough to support a small team. It is 100% FOSS with no paid feature tiers, and is sponsored by Portainer.
mentions.problem: To avoid Kubernetes complexity, the author's previous startup moved to Heroku and was charged exorbitant amounts—close to $400k in a year for what should have cost $10–15k in cloud costs.
mentions.audience: Small to midsized teams of developers, with a goal of being easy enough for even a single developer to feel comfortable with.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on https://canine.sh, an open source, self hosted PaaS for Kubernetes.
